hero.title: 1947 Restaurant: Authentic Indian Flavors, Unforgettable Dining Experiences
hero.subtitle: Savor a rich tapestry of regional Indian cuisine, crafted with passion and tradition.

about.title: Our Story: A Culinary Journey Through India
about.paragraph1: 1947 Restaurant is more than just a name; it's a tribute to the rich heritage and diverse culinary landscape of India. Our mission is to transport you on a gastronomic adventure, meticulously preparing each dish with authentic spices and time-honored techniques, ensuring a true taste of tradition in every bite.
about.paragraph2: From the vibrant street food of Delhi to the royal curries of Rajasthan and the coastal delights of Kerala, our menu is a curated celebration of India's regional specialties. We invite you to experience our warm hospitality and immerse yourself in an ambiance that reflects the true spirit and flavors of incredible India.
